items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: he's a beautiful, beautiful trombone player and he played, I played and we had a wonderful time

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

bandstand I heard so much about, George Masso, he's a beautiful, beautiful trombone player and he played, I played and we had a wonderful time, and he was a beautiful trombone player; and when we were on the plane coming back from Galveston before we got into the airport at LaGuardia, I walked over to George Masso and said, 'George, from now on you're one of my favorite trombone players. You played so great tonight' He thanked me for it and then I said, George, from now on you'll be called the 'Son of Chief,' and…
What about 'Chief' and 'Big Chief,' when did they start calling you that? How long ago?
